intro: Acts tells what happened after Jesus rose: how a small group of his followers carried the good news from Jerusalem to Rome.
Chapters one to twelve: the coming of the Holy Spirit at Pentecost, the growth of the church in Jerusalem, and the conversion of Saul.
Chapters thirteen to twenty-eight: Saul, now called Paul, travels the Roman world, and finally reaches Rome in chains.
Tradition holds that Luke wrote it, continuing his Gospel.
Listen for Jesus' words in chapter one, which the rest of the book fulfils: ye shall be witnesses unto me, unto the uttermost part of the earth.
